title: Low Profile Brake Bleeder Adapter for Pure Brake Fluid Exchanger Machines
lead: MOC has developed a new Low Profile Brake Bleeder Adapter that provides improved access to the hard to reach wheel areas when installing the machine's bleeder lines. This new kit is now available to replace the existing brake bleeders that currently come with the Brake Fluid Exchanger Machines.
body: These new Low Profile Brake Bleeder Adapters will soon become standard on all new orders of Brake Fluid Exchanger Machines.
